title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: surcharge uplift by trade lane
content:
## Rule
For the hazardous-cargo surcharge written at loading under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the uplift of the acceptance's trade lane is 20 percent for Transpacific Eastbound and for Asia – US East Coast, 15 percent for Transatlantic Westbound, 10 percent for Asia – Middle East and India and for Europe – South America East Coast, and 0 for every other lane. The lane is the one recorded on the acceptance.

## Lane uplift (the same figures for every category)
| Trade lane | Lane uplift (percent) |
|---|---|
| Transpacific Eastbound | 20 |
| Asia – US East Coast | 20 |
| Transatlantic Westbound | 15 |
| Asia – Middle East and India | 10 |
| Europe – South America East Coast | 10 |
| Asia – North Europe | 0 |
| Asia – Mediterranean | 0 |
| Intra-Asia | 0 |

The figures are identical for AHL DG Limited Quantity, AHL DG Class 9 Standard, AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives, AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers, AHL DG Compressed Gases and AHL DG Special Approval.

## Basis Q&A
- *Does AHL DG Limited Quantity waive the lane uplift?* No; the lane figures apply to it as to every other category.
- *Goods on Intra-Asia?* 0 percent.
